description: Use this when someone names the monthly amount they want to take home in Ghana cedis and asks what basic salary gives it (for example "what salary do I ask for to take home 5,000 cedis"). Do not use it when the salary is already known: use pay.take_home. Do not use it for contractor fees or business income.

allowances.description: Taxable cash allowances a month in Ghana cedis, on top of basic salary. Leave out if none.

month.description: The month the pay is for, as YYYY-MM. Leave out for the bands in force now.

pays_ssnit.description: Whether social security (SSNIT) is taken from the pay. Leave out for yes.

resident.description: Whether the person is resident in Ghana for tax. Leave out for yes.

take_home.description: The take-home pay wanted a month, in Ghana cedis.

name: pay.salary_for_take_home
title: Salary needed for a take-home amount in Ghana
